## Summary

Fifth installment of the breakout family: **BoS**, an **intraday** long/short QQQ algo — first intraday member of the series. Four variants of the same strategy trade a **single $25k account** (2x max leverage → up to $50k intraday size). Correlations: **-0.05 to QQQ buy-and-hold**, 0.37 to UnoMas ([[2026-10-28-margincall4-breakout-10y-tsla-extension]]), 0.38 to BoB ([[2026-10-31-margincall4-bob-l-s-qqq-low-corr]]) — the three L/S books are now pairwise 0.37–0.44 while sitting ~0 to the underlying.

Chart metrics, 2011–2026, after costs (OCR-approximate cells):

|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Combined | 25,092 | 1,586 | 29.4% | 1.18 | 22.6% | **-18.3%** | 1.31 | **5.20** |

## Why it matters

- The ensemble thesis is compounding: a third L/S book at 0.37–0.44 pairwise correlation, ~0 to QQQ, is exactly the diversifier budget the series has been building since [[2026-10-27-margincall4-l-s-breakout-portfolio-addition]] — and this one extends the family to intraday holding periods. Same architectural argument as [[2026-10-31-futako1013-17-edge-index-forward-first]]: pool imperfectly-correlated edges rather than pick one.
- **Ensembling math worth internalizing:** four variants each at Sharpe ~1.0–1.2 / 5–6%/yr combine to 22.6%/yr at Sharpe 1.31. But the combined t (5.20) is far below the ~8.7 you'd get pooling four uncorrelated t≈4.4 books — back-of-envelope, the variants are ~0.6 correlated **with each other**. They're four parameterizations of one bet, not four strategies. The combined MaxDD (-18.3%) being WORSE than every single variant's (-5.0 to -9.8%) says the same thing: drawdowns overlap in time.
- **Skepticism gates:** the equity bars don't obviously reconcile with the table — if all curves start at $25k, variants ending at $21–24k are net losers despite claimed 5–6%/yr; if each variant runs a quarter of the account (~$6k start), $21–24k terminal implies ~9%/yr compounded, above the table's per-variant cell. Capital-allocation convention needs pinning down before quoting 22.6%/yr. Also self-reported, OCR cells approximate, and the author's own validation bar ([[2026-10-28-margincall4-overfitting-validation-dsr-pbo-walkforward]]) applies: combined t 5.20 passes his >3 screen, per-variant t 3.92–4.80 pass too, but 1,586 trades/yr makes multiple-testing haircuts cheap to apply and mandatory.
